notes:
Bauru (SP) has NO metro/tram/rail; operator runs urban buses only (route_type=3). Grande Bauru operates ~49-60 lines under the Transurb consortium. This feed models 6 representative high-traffic lines (0033 Gasparini, 4600 Mary Dota, 7800 Vargem Limpa, 9600 Tibirica, 3288 UNESP/Camelias-Falcao/ITE, 0518 Vila Dutra-Bauru Shopping), each both directions with WKDY/SAT/SUN service. Full feed on disk at /home/ubuntu/adresses/gtfs_bauru/ (agency/stops/routes/trips/stop_times/calendar .txt): 15 stops, 6 routes, 727 trips, 3357 stop_times, generated by build.py from the published first/last departures + derived headways. This structured payload includes ALL stops/routes/calendar/agency but only a REPRESENTATIVE 36 trips (first trip per route/dir/service) with complete ordered stop_times to stay compact; the on-disk feed has every headway-spaced trip.
DATA SOURCES: itineraries + real departure-time tables from onibus.online line pages (e.g. /sp/bauru/0033-gasparini-centro/) and horariodeonibusbauru.com; line roster cross-checked across onibus.online, horariodeonibusbauru.com, horariosdeonibus.net (~60-67 lines listed, ids differ slightly per site). transurbbauru.com.br confirmed operator (24h, 160 buses, ~65k pax/day) but has no per-line detail. Moovit deep pages and OSM Overpass were unreachable (JS-rendered / outbound TCP blocked in sandbox), so stop-level ordering beyond terminals+major corridor points is not modeled.
COORDINATES: terminals/hubs geocoded via OSM Nominatim (WGS-84): Praca Machado de Mello, Terminal Rodoviario, Bauru Shopping, UNESP campus, Mary Dota, Vargem Limpa, Gasparini, Tibirica. Corridor waypoints (Av. Nacoes Unidas, Rodrigues Alves, Nuno de Assis, Camelias, Falcao/ITE, Quinta Bela Olinda, Vila Dutra) are approximate WGS-84 placements along the central axis, not surveyed stop nodes.
CONFIDENCE 0.55: departure times, service days, route roster and terminal coords are faithful to published schedules; intermediate stop lists are compressed to a few real corridor points (not the full street-by-street stop sequence), and only 6 of ~49 lines are modeled. Inter-stop 4-min hops are estimated. No stops were invented — every stop is an evidenced terminal, hub, or named corridor avenue.
